verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of bulk user import, password-hash import, or user export for Supabase Auth. The nearest items are linking auth data to your own tables with triggers and a community remark that copying user data to a public table is trivial. Both are adjacent workarounds, not a documented migration capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bulk-import existing users — including password hashes — and export them again, so I am never locked in
